title: Vox orchestrator daemon JSON-line dispatch request
description: One JSON object per line on stdin/stdout or TCP (`id`, `method`, `params`) for `vox-orchestrator-d` (`orch.*`). Separate from DeI `ai.*` contracts.

params.description: Method-specific payload; validated in daemon dispatch. For `orch.subscribe_events`, an optional `from_offset` (u64) requests replay-from-offset (T1.3): every durable Tier-A op with `op_id > from_offset` is pushed before the live tail begins.

auth_token.description: Optional shared-secret daemon auth token (T0.2). A top-level field set exclusively by the transport layer (`OrchDaemonClient`), never by params-composing tool-call code. When the daemon has a configured token, a request whose `auth_token` does not match is rejected before any dispatch.

permission_mode.description: GUI-selected PermissionMode wire string (T0.3: "ask" | "accept_edits" | "accept_all" | "plan"), consulted by the dangerous-tool HITL gate in orch.tool_call. A top-level field set exclusively by the transport layer, same isolation rationale as auth_token.
